features.statement: Page title is short and concise rather than a long keyword-stuffed string.
Page has exactly one h1 serving as the hero headline, with a coherent heading hierarchy.
Headings are properly nested, with product names and footer columns as h3 under h2 sections.
Image alt texts descriptively match the image content or product name rather than SEO keywords.
Header is slim and single-row, with a small logo, few text links and a highlighted phone number.
Hero is two-column: headline, subtext and buttons on the left, one rounded image on the right.
Hero has a large bold serif headline, a supporting subheading paragraph, and two pill call-to-action buttons.
Buttons are fully rounded pills in a solid green fill, with outlined pill variants as secondary.
Headings use a serif face (Georgia) at bold weight, paired with system sans-serif body text.
Body text is slightly larger, about 17px, with generous line height.
Palette is dark forest green with green accents on a warm cream page background.
Section backgrounds alternate between cream and pale sage green to separate content bands.
Sale badges are small green pills placed beside the price, not corner ribbons.
Prices are bold and green, with the original struck-through price in muted grey.
Feature sections alternate image left and right in a zig-zag, with text directly on the background.
Images, tiles and cards have softly rounded corners and no hard outlines.
Layout uses CSS grid for sections alongside flexbox.
Link groups are left-aligned under the heading on a plain background and styled as small outlined pills.
Newsletter signup is a standalone centred section with a large email input and a green button.
Dark footer repeats the white logo with a tagline and bolds only the contact labels.
Payment icons are small and sit inside a white rounded box within the dark footer.
Text-heavy content sits in a narrow centred white card with left-aligned lines.
Content column is relatively narrow, with generous side margins.
Markup is lean and self-contained: one style block, no scripts and a small handwritten class vocabulary.
Effects are restrained, with few shadows, transitions and animations and only a soft shadow on the hero image.
Page has minimal forms and controls, with a single signup form and one input.
